session_summary: A synthetic workplace meeting was separated into observable facts and the user's interpretation.

event_candidates.title: Stayed silent during a project meeting
facts: The manager asked whether anyone objected.
The user did not voice their concern.
interpretations: The user thought disagreement might be unwelcome.

claim_candidates.statement: In this meeting, anticipated evaluation may have contributed to withholding disagreement.
alternative_explanations: The user may not yet have had enough information to explain the concern.

assistant_response: The observable part is that you had a concern and stayed silent after the manager asked for objections. You interpreted the pause as a sign disagreement would be unwelcome. What did you notice in your body at that moment?
